name: angular-bridge-poc
description: Angular iframe/custom-event PoC using ds-sfcc-contract transports

scripts.build:cdn: npm run build:iframe && npm run build:custom-event && node scripts/prepare-cdn.mjs
scripts.deploy:s3: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && aws s3 sync dist/acme-bridge-poc/browser/ s3://${CDN_BUCKET}/bridge-poc/${npm_package_version}/ --cache-control 'public,max-age=31536000,immutable'
scripts.deploy:entry: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && aws s3 cp dist/acme-bridge-poc/browser/test.html s3://${CDN_BUCKET}/bridge-poc/test.html --cache-control 'no-cache' --content-type 'text/html'
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:s3 && npm run deploy:entry && npm run invalidate:cf
